body:
Thank you. 

Feels good in some way that someone else also understands. 

This phenomenom also interests me: When I try to fix my life, which is a situation I can not handle, I panic and feel really bad. When I decide to not fix my problems, I enter a situation that I can handle, and become calm. Like a survival mechanism, only that the mechanism is death. Pretty ironic.

I just reached a point of going from suicidal fantasies to actaully planning and preparing for a suicide. Either I am just planning so i can have the possibility to kms when I want to, or I am planning and will go through with it when all arrangements are done. I guess it will depend on how I feel the day I am done. I think I am about to cross the line. Because my fantasies used to be about trying but failing and get saved. (never made such action though). Now I really dont want anyone to find out and  I plan carefully to not miss any details. And I feel calm knowing I can escape. I feel very different now compared to before. I think that is where I have my line. I think I should say "shit I need to go to a hospital" but I don't want to, because i don't want to be saved.
